claims.head: The Red Wings aren’t Daccord’s kryptonite
claims.body: Daccord has been shaky against the Red Wings since 2023-24, well below his usual. It looks like a pattern, but across three seasons a goalie’s record against one team told us nothing about the next meeting. Expect the usual Daccord.
claims.nums: 6 starts against Detroit: .870 save percentage · .911 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Daccord’s record against the Red Wings.
claims.call: If Daccord starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .911 than to his .870 against the Red Wings.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 6 against Detroit, 4,103 shots against everyone else

check.rule: held if he starts and his save percentage is closer to his usual than to his record against this team; can't judge if he doesn't start

claims.head: Special teams lean toward the Red Wings
claims.call: The Red Wings’ power play creates at least their usual 8.6 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Red Wings’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Kraken’s kill is one of the league’s worst. The Kraken need to stay out of the box.
claims.nums: Detroit 4th for power play (8.6 expected goals per 60) · Seattle 28th for penalty kill
claims.gist: The Red Wings’ power play has a soft target in the Kraken’s kill.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 4 games this season

check.measure: expected goals per 60 on the power play
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

DET.head: Detroit should have the upper hand
DET.body: Detroit has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Seattle’s way back in is keeping dangerous shots away.

SEA.head: A tough matchup for Seattle
SEA.body: Detroit has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Seattle’s best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.
